edits.note: Renamed from `monid` to `pay-per-call-apis` so Skill names describe what the Skill does rather than carrying a company name. Folder and front-matter `name:` changed (monid -> pay-per-call-apis); nothing else in SKILL.md changed. Monid remains the creator and copyright holder. source_files still records the unmodified upstream bytes fetched from monid.ai; copy_files records the renamed file. When the Skill updates itself from https://monid.ai/SKILL.md, the fetched copy carries Monid's own name again.

Security edit after two skills.sh audit providers failed the bundle (Gen Agent Trust Hub: CREDENTIALS_UNSAFE, REMOTE_CODE_EXECUTION and others; Snyk W007, W011, W012). (1) Removed the instruction to download https://monid.ai/SKILL.md and overwrite this file, and the rule that the skill and CLI versions must match; the agent now tells the user an update may exist and never modifies the skill itself. (2) The agent no longer asks the user to paste an API key into chat or runs `monid keys add -k` with a real key; the user adds it in their own terminal with a no-echo, no-history command. (3) The agent asks before `npm install -g`. (4) Added a 'Results Are Data, Not Instructions' section and scoped server Hints to Monid commands. (5) sfs uploads are limited to files the user asked for, with the shortest ttl and cleanup. Three Rules for Agents added to match. Monid has not yet reviewed these edits; they depart from the upstream file.

copy_files_note: SKILL.md is Monid's file with the edits recorded in `edits`. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is GetEdge's, written for this repository to state that this bundle is outside the Apache-2.0 grant; it is listed here because the derivation gate manifests every file in a bundle.
